name: Taira no Atsumori
source:
A Heike nobleman.
One of the Hachiyou that protects the Priestess, the Genbu of Heaven.
He joined the protagonist's group after she found him collapsed on a battlefield.
He doesn't speak a lot and doesn't like to associate with people.
He is cooperating with the protagonist in order to purify the apparitions.
translation:
A Heike nobleman.
One of the Hachiyou that protects the Priestess, the Genbu of Heaven.
He joined the protagonist's group after she found him collapsed on a battlefield.
He doesn't speak a lot and doesn't like to associate with people.
He is cooperating with the protagonist in order to purify the apparitions.
